# orbivisor_storage_pool (Data Source)

A storage pool (pools are node configuration, so they are read here rather than managed).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `available_bytes` (Number)
- `backend` (String) Backend kind (`dir`, `nfs`, `lvm-thin`, `zfs`, `rbd`…).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `nodes` (List of String) Node ids that may use it (empty: all).
- `shared` (Boolean)
- `total_bytes` (Number)
